description: UI harness smoke: the ImGui Test Engine can locate and drive real editor windows headless. Asserts the main windows exist, focuses two of them, and captures a full-window screenshot (artifact for human/AI inspection; deliberately NOT hash-compared -- UI pixels vary by ini/dock state and font rasterization, and a golden here would be pure flake). Window titles must match the ImGui::Begin strings; if a rename breaks this test, update the refs.
